title: Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2605.20254v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising results on NLP tasks, however, their performance on tabular data still needs research attention, because Table Question-Answering (TQA) requires precise cell retrieval and multi-step structured reasoning. Existing work improves TQA either by fine-tuning or training LLMs on task-specific tabular data, but often lacks verifiable control over how the model navigates tables and derives answers. In this work, we propose a training-free TQA approach with two structured prompting frameworks: TableGrid Navigation (TGN), which iteratively navigates rows and columns via a three-module loop to locate evidence and refine answers, and Progressive Inference Prompting (PIP), which enforces columns identification for explicit progressive row selection constraint according to the query. translated_title: 通过表格网格导航与渐进式推理提示实现高效表格问答
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言处理任务上展示了有前景的结果，然而，它们在表格数据上的表现仍需研究关注，因为表格问答（TQA）需要精确的单元格检索和多步结构化推理。现有工作通过微调或在特定任务表格数据上训练LLMs来改进TQA，但通常缺乏对模型如何导航表格和推导答案的可验证控制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种无需训练的TQA方法，包含两种结构化提示框架：表格网格导航（TGN），通过三模块循环迭代地导航行和列以定位证据并细化答案；以及渐进式推理提示（PIP），根据查询强制列识别以实现显式的渐进式行选择约束。我们在TableBench和FeTaQa数据集上评估了17个LLMs与6个基线。在TableBench上，TGN相比基线提高了...
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的表格问答方法，通过表格网格导航和渐进式推理提示两种结构化提示框架，增强大型语言模型在表格上的精确检索与多步推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free table QA approach with two structured prompting frameworks, TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting, to enhance LLMs' precise retrieval and multi-step reasoning on tabular data.
